name: application-sheet
title: Sheet
description: Right-edge slide-in panel for editing or inspecting a record without leaving the current page, built on the native dialog element.
useWhen: Editing or inspecting a single record while keeping the underlying page context visible behind a scrim.
The content is too long or form-heavy for a centered modal but doesn't warrant a full page navigation.
You want a mobile-friendly edit surface that slides in from the edge of the screen.
avoidWhen: The action is a simple yes/no confirmation — use a centered dialog instead.
The panel needs to stay open alongside other panels — use a persistent sidebar layout instead.
Content is short enough to fit inline or in a popover anchored to a trigger element.
responsiveBehavior: The panel spans the full viewport height and clamps to a max width of 24rem (max-w-sm), growing to fill the width on small screens.
accessibility: Uses the native <dialog> element via showModal(), which traps focus and is dismissible with the Escape key automatically.
aria-labelledby and aria-describedby associate the panel with its title and description for screen readers.
The scrim/backdrop and an explicit close button both provide a way to dismiss the panel.

variants.title: Sheet
variants.description: Right-edge slide-in panel with header, scrollable form body, and footer actions, backed by the native dialog element.
accessibility: Focus moves into the panel on open and returns to the trigger on close, handled natively by <dialog>.

variants.title: Sheet (Dark)
variants.description: Right-edge slide-in panel adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Panel background and border colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
